name: night-city
label: Night City (cyberpunk, dark only)

accent.meaning: needs you / operator action (notice yellow, black legend)

concept: Night City corporate-street interface (genre reference: Cyberpunk 2077 menus). Coral-red chrome for every frame, label and tab; cyan only for what is selected or live; notice yellow only for what needs you; category colors as thin left-edge bars. Cut-corner hairline frames, condensed caps headers, big numbers with small units, micro-data only at the edges. No glow, no blue chrome.
